candidate_evidence.quote: intensity-modulated irradiation scheme with integrated boost technique (SIB) guided by PET FDOPA during the chemo-radiotherapy

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: In this project, the investigators propose to use the integrated boost technique (SIB) guided by PET FDOPA to increase the radiation dose in GBM, in patients either fragile and partially operated, or only biopsied and for whom the prognosis is the most pejorative.

role_evidence.quote: Integrated boost technique (SIB) guided by PET FDOPA

agents.drug_class_hint: 18F-DOPA PET imaging tracer (fluorine-18) used to define radiotherapy boost volume

role_evidence.quote: Some frail patients received hypofractionated radiation and concomitant and adjuvant TMZ.

source_quote.quote: Correlate O6-Methylguanine-DNA Methyltransferase (MGMT) promoter methylation status and Overall survival

coder_notes: Radiotherapy dose-escalation (SIB) trial guided by 18F-DOPA PET; no pharmacological candidate. Temozolomide listed as backbone because the intervention is delivered 'during the chemo-radiotherapy' and TMZ is the named chemotherapy; the record does not explicitly state every patient receives TMZ (patients are unfit for full Stupp). FDOPA PET uptake is an eligibility imaging criterion, not a molecular biomarker, so not listed as a biomarker.
